verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Export API for pulling a project's raw event data and a Dashboard REST API that returns chart and query results as JSON. A cohort export API and a published OpenAPI spec back this up. missing for 10: evidence of ad-hoc or arbitrary analytical query semantics beyond dashboard-chart data, details on export format, granularity and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run analytical queries and pull raw event data back through a documented query/export API

citations.quote: Get data that's displayed on the dashboard graphs in JSON format through the Dashboard REST API.
List all your cohorts in Amplitude, export a cohort in Amplitude, or upload a cohort.
